name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Fixed federated playback permanently stalling partway through long streams (most visible on clients like Safari/iOS that need an audio transcode - e.g. an EAC-3/Dolby Digital+ track Safari can't play natively - since that's the only path that routes the stream through FederationStreamHandler's relay as FFmpeg's transcode input). The relay retries a stalled/dropped upstream read, but its retry budget (3 attempts) was a lifetime cap for the whole stream instead of resetting as the transfer made progress: any 4th hiccup anywhere across a long WAN relay to a friend's server - not unusual over the runtime of a 90+ minute movie - permanently aborted the connection with no way to recover, silently killing the HLS segment feed and leaving the player buffering forever. The budget now resets on every chunk actually relayed, so only repeated stalls with no progress in between exhaust it. 244 tests, all green.
